description: This file defines FastAPI API routes related to queue management for test cases, including listing, adding, and removing items from the queue. It utilizes dependency injection for database sessions and user authentication, and interacts with services for queue operations and audit logging.

methods.name: get_queue( current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve the list of queued test cases.

methods.name: add_to_queue( queue_data: QueueAddRequest, request: Request, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add test cases to the queue, with auditing and error handling.

methods.name: remove_from_queue( case_id: str, request: Request, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a specific test case from the queue, with success check and audit logging.
